SELECT
  ad.name AS activity_name,
  COUNT(ai.id) AS completed_instances
FROM activity_instances ai
JOIN activity_definitions ad ON ad.id = ai.activity_definition_id
WHERE (ai.completed = true OR ai.time_stop IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(ai.duration_seconds, 0) > 0)
  AND COALESCE(ai.time_stop, ai.time_start, ai.created_at) >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00'
  AND COALESCE(ai.time_stop, ai.time_start, ai.created_at) <= '2026-03-31T23:59:59'
  AND ai.activity_definition_id IN ('activity-1', 'activity-2')
GROUP BY ad.name
HAVING COUNT(ai.id) > 0
ORDER BY completed_instances DESC, activity_name ASC
LIMIT 15

WITH ordered_values AS (
  SELECT
    ai.id AS activity_instance_id,
    COALESCE(ai.time_stop, ai.time_start, ai.created_at)::date AS instance_date,
    md.name AS metric_name,
    mv.value::numeric AS metric_value,
    LAG(mv.value::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY mv.metric_definition_id ORDER BY COALESCE(ai.time_stop, ai.time_start, ai.created_at), ai.id) AS previous_metric_value
  FROM metric_values mv
  JOIN activity_instances ai ON ai.id = mv.activity_instance_id
  JOIN metric_definitions md ON md.id = mv.metric_definition_id
WHERE COALESCE(ai.time_stop, ai.time_start, ai.created_at) >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00'
  AND COALESCE(ai.time_stop, ai.time_start, ai.created_at) <= '2026-03-31T23:59:59'
  AND ai.activity_definition_id IN ('activity-1', 'activity-2')
)
SELECT
  activity_instance_id,
  instance_date,
  metric_name,
  ROUND(((metric_value - previous_metric_value) / NULLIF(previous_metric_value, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pct_change
FROM ordered_values
WHERE previous_metric_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY instance_date ASC, activity_instance_id ASC
LIMIT 5000

WITH metric_points AS (

  FROM metric_values mv
  JOIN activity_instances ai ON ai.id = mv.activity_instance_id

WHERE COALESCE(ai.time_stop, ai.time_start, ai.created_at) >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00'
  AND COALESCE(ai.time_stop, ai.time_start, ai.created_at) <= '2026-03-31T23:59:59'
  AND ai.activity_definition_id IN ('activity-1', 'activity-2')
), paired_points AS (
  SELECT
    activity_instance_id,
    instance_date,
    MAX(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_id = 'x_metric') AS x_value,
    MAX(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_id = 'y_metric') AS y_value
  FROM metric_points
  GROUP BY activity_instance_id, instance_date
)
SELECT activity_instance_id, instance_date, x_value, y_value
FROM paired_points
WHERE x_value IS NOT NULL AND y_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY instance_date ASC, activity_instance_id ASC
LIMIT 5000

SELECT
  COALESCE(gl.name, 'Goal') AS goal_level,
  COUNT(g.id) AS total_goals,
  SUM(CASE WHEN g.completed = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_goals,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN g.completed = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(g.id), 0)) * 100)::integer AS completion_rate
FROM goals g
LEFT JOIN goal_levels gl ON gl.id = g.level_id
WHERE g.id IN ('goal-1')
GROUP BY COALESCE(gl.name, 'Goal')
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC, goal_level ASC

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN EXTRACT(day FROM (NOW() - g.created_at)) <= 7 THEN '0-7 days'
    WHEN EXTRACT(day FROM (NOW() - g.created_at)) <= 30 THEN '8-30 days'
    WHEN EXTRACT(day FROM (NOW() - g.created_at)) <= 90 THEN '31-90 days'
    ELSE '90+ days'
  END AS age_bucket,
  COUNT(g.id) AS active_goals
FROM goals g
WHERE g.completed = false
  AND g.id IN ('goal-1')
GROUP BY age_bucket
ORDER BY MIN(g.created_at) DESC
LIMIT 5000

WITH direct_activity AS (
  SELECT
    aga.goal_id,
    MAX(COALESCE(ai.time_stop, ai.time_start, ai.created_at)) AS last_activity_at
  FROM activity_goal_associations aga
  JOIN activity_instances ai ON ai.activity_definition_id = aga.activity_id
  GROUP BY aga.goal_id
), direct_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    sg.goal_id,
    MAX(COALESCE(s.session_start, s.created_at)) AS last_session_at
  FROM session_goals sg
  JOIN sessions s ON s.id = sg.session_id
  GROUP BY sg.goal_id
), goal_activity AS (
  SELECT
    g.id,
    g.name,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(da.last_activity_at, g.created_at),
      COALESCE(ds.last_session_at, g.created_at),
      g.created_at
    ) AS last_activity_at
  FROM goals g
  LEFT JOIN direct_activity da ON da.goal_id = g.id
  LEFT JOIN direct_sessions ds ON ds.goal_id = g.id
WHERE g.completed = false
  AND g.id IN ('goal-1')
)
SELECT
  id AS goal_id,
  name AS goal_name,
  FLOOR(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (NOW() - last_activity_at)) / 86400)::integer AS days_stale
FROM goal_activity
WHERE last_activity_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
ORDER BY days_stale DESC, goal_name ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH durations AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(0, ROUND(COALESCE(s.duration_seconds, 0) / 60.0)::integer) AS minutes
  FROM sessions s
WHERE COALESCE(s.session_start, s.created_at) >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00'
  AND COALESCE(s.session_start, s.created_at) <= '2026-03-31T23:59:59'
), bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(MAX(minutes), 1) AS max_minutes FROM durations
), buckets AS (
  SELECT
    generate_series(0, 4) AS bucket_index,
    CEIL((SELECT max_minutes FROM bounds)::numeric / 5)::integer AS bucket_size
)
SELECT
  bucket_index,
  bucket_index * bucket_size AS start_minutes,
  CASE WHEN bucket_index = 4 THEN NULL ELSE (bucket_index + 1) * bucket_size END AS end_minutes,
  COUNT(d.minutes) AS sessions
FROM buckets
LEFT JOIN durations d
  ON d.minutes >= bucket_index * bucket_size
  AND (bucket_index = 4 OR d.minutes < (bucket_index + 1) * bucket_size)
GROUP BY bucket_index, bucket_size
ORDER BY bucket_index ASC

  SELECT GREATEST(0, ROUND(COALESCE(s.duration_seconds, 0) / 60.0)::integer) AS minutes
  FROM sessions s
), bounds AS (

), buckets AS (
  SELECT
    generate_series(0, 4) AS bucket_index,
    CEIL((SELECT max_minutes FROM bounds)::numeric / 5)::integer AS bucket_size
)
SELECT
  bucket_index,
  bucket_index * bucket_size AS start_minutes,
  CASE WHEN bucket_index = 4 THEN NULL ELSE (bucket_index + 1) * bucket_size END AS end_minutes,
  COUNT(d.minutes) AS sessions
FROM buckets

  ON d.minutes >= bucket_index * bucket_size
  AND (bucket_index = 4 OR d.minutes < (bucket_index + 1) * bucket_size)
GROUP BY bucket_index, bucket_size
ORDER BY bucket_index ASC

WITH expanded_sections AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(section->>'name', 'Unnamed section') AS section_name,
    COALESCE((section->>'duration_minutes')::numeric * 60, 0) AS duration_seconds
  FROM sessions s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE((s.attributes::jsonb #> '{session_data,sections}'), '[]'::jsonb)) AS section
WHERE COALESCE(s.session_start, s.created_at) >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00'
  AND COALESCE(s.session_start, s.created_at) <= '2026-03-31T23:59:59'
)
SELECT
  section_name,
  ROUND(SUM(duration_seconds) / 60.0)::integer AS minutes
FROM expanded_sections
GROUP BY section_name
HAVING SUM(duration_seconds) > 0
ORDER BY minutes DESC
LIMIT 5000

WITH hours AS (
  SELECT generate_series(0, 23) AS hour
)
SELECT

  COUNT(s.id) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(hour FROM COALESCE(s.session_start, s.created_at)) = hours.hour) AS session_start
FROM hours
LEFT JOIN sessions s ON true
WHERE COALESCE(s.session_start, s.created_at) >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00'
  AND COALESCE(s.session_start, s.created_at) <= '2026-03-31T23:59:59'
GROUP BY hours.hour
ORDER BY hours.hour ASC

  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(s.duration_seconds, 0)) / 60.0)::integer AS avg_minutes
FROM sessions s
WHERE COALESCE(s.session_start, s.created_at) >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00'
  AND COALESCE(s.session_start, s.created_at) <= '2026-03-31T23:59:59'
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  COUNT(s.id) AS total_sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.completed = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_sessions,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(s.duration_seconds, 0)) / 60.0)::integer AS total_minutes,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(s.duration_seconds, 0)) / 60.0)::integer AS avg_minutes
FROM sessions s
LIMIT 1

WITH practice_days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(s.session_start, s.created_at)::date AS practice_day
  FROM sessions s
WHERE COALESCE(s.session_start, s.created_at) >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00'
  AND COALESCE(s.session_start, s.created_at) <= '2026-03-31T23:59:59'
), grouped_days AS (
  SELECT
    practice_day,
    practice_day - (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY practice_day))::integer AS streak_group
  FROM practice_days
)
SELECT
  MIN(practice_day) AS streak_start,
  MAX(practice_day) AS streak_end,
  COUNT(*) AS active_days
FROM grouped_days
GROUP BY streak_group
ORDER BY streak_start ASC
LIMIT 5000
